skill_name: Explain why changing our diet to one without processed food and animal products is beneficial for our health.
workflow: Changing to a diet without processed food and animal products can have a huge impact on our overall health. Firstly, processed foods usually contain a lot of added sugar, preservatives and other unhealthy additives which can lead to serious health problems like chronic inflammation, cancer and diabetes.
